purpose: Super Admin binds Warden role to specific hostel
preconditions: Hostel exists; Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: Role binding active and recorded

purpose: Student cannot access hostel data outside allocated hostel
preconditions: Student is allocated to Hostel 1
action_or_input: Student attempts to access data for Hostel 2
expected_result: UnauthorizedHostelAccessError / Access refused

purpose: Super Admin has institution-wide access across all hostels
preconditions: Multiple hostels exist; Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returning all hostels in institute

purpose: Role binding records time-bound start and end dates
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and validity dates preserved

purpose: User without required permission is refused action
preconditions: Student authenticated without hostel.allotment.manage permission
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden refusal

purpose: Newly reassigned role holder can view pending records for assigned hostel
preconditions: Hostel has pending leave; new Caretaker role binding is assigned
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK showing the pending leave request

purpose: System records allotment decision and updates room assignment info
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated and room has capacity
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created, active allotment saved

purpose: Room assignment history is retained when room is vacated or exchanged
preconditions: Student has active allotment; room vacation recorded
expected_result: Allotment record status changed to vacated with vacated_at timestamp retained

purpose: System prevents room occupancy from exceeding defined room capacity
preconditions: Room capacity is 2 and current occupancy is 2
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request / CapacityExceededError and occupancy remains 2

purpose: Attendance records are retained for reporting and compliance
preconditions: Caretaker records attendance for a date
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK returning the recorded attendance rows

purpose: Leave history is permanently retained for review and reporting
preconditions: Leave decision recorded as approved or rejected
expected_result: Historical decided leave requests remain queryable

purpose: Complaint without mandatory description or category is refused
preconditions: Student authenticated with hostel.complaint.create
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request / MandatoryFieldMissingError refusal

purpose: Complaint outside hostel-operational scope is refused
preconditions: Student submits complaint with non-hostel category
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request / ScopeBoundaryError refusal

purpose: Caretaker can escalate unresolved supervisory complaint to Warden
preconditions: Submitted complaint exists in assigned hostel
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK and complaint escalated_at recorded

purpose: Guest-room booking history is retained for audit and review
preconditions: Guest booking request approved
expected_result: Past booking history remains visible

purpose: System records extended-stay charge amount when approved
preconditions: Extended stay request in submitted state
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with charge_amount=2000.00 and compliance_status=pending

purpose: System records payment deadline and compliance status for extended stay
preconditions: Extended stay approved with payment deadline
expected_result: Payment deadline and compliance status preserved

purpose: Fine record missing reason, positive amount, date, or student is refused
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated with hostel.fine.record
action_or_input: POST /api/v1/hostel/fines with amount=0 or empty reason
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request / MandatoryFieldMissingError refusal

purpose: Hostel inventory items and staff duty logs are stored and audited
preconditions: Caretaker authenticated with operations permissions
action_or_input: POST inventory and staff duty logs
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created with updated_by_user_id audit fields

purpose: Security guard shift schedules are maintained in HM
preconditions: Warden authenticated with hostel.security.manage
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created and shift recorded

purpose: Caretaker or Warden cannot publish notices for an unassigned hostel
preconditions: Caretaker assigned only to Hostel 1
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request / NoticePermissionError refusal

purpose: Notice history is retained for transparency and audit
preconditions: Notice published with is_active flag
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK and notices remain in archive

purpose: Hostel notice board displays relevant campus and assigned hostel notices
preconditions: Campus notice and hostel-specific notice exist
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK displaying both campus-wide and student hostel notices

purpose: Predefined reports provide operational summaries derived from HM records
preconditions: Hostel has rooms, leaves, complaints, and fines
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with occupancy rate and pending item counts

purpose: System issues notifications for supported HM workflow events
preconditions: Allotment, leave decision, or fine recorded for student
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK with relevant notification rows

purpose: Caretaker operations denied outside assigned hostel context
preconditions: Caretaker assigned only to Hostel 1
action_or_input: Caretaker attempts to record attendance or leaves for Hostel 2
expected_result: UnauthorizedHostelAccessError / refused
